release_line: stable (4.1, not 4.2, is the upstream LTS branch)
security_review: Reviewed 4.2.0 release notes and July 2026 advisories. Use DTLS 1.2 pure PSK AES-128-GCM only; no renegotiation, resumption, CID, RSA, ECC, X.509, PKCS7 or TLS 1.3. PSA allocation, RNG and error boundaries require the native regression gates.
